scientific_integrity: Proof gives a complete positive-integer conic descent and exact bounded enumeration. All primality for surviving entries is verified by complete deterministic trial division; finite verification does not assert a global conjecture.
scientific_limitations: The exact census is bounded by max(p,q) <= 2^160. It does not classify primes beyond this bound or prove an unbounded prime-pair infinitude or finiteness result. General Vieta descent is classical. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed for unindexed tables.
title: Exact sub-160-bit census of third–fourth order reciprocal prime pairs
